lore.name: Luminara
lore.description: An era of Luminaran history veiled in darkness by the overreach of the Council of Angels.

burgs.name: Luminaris
burgs.note: Located at the fork of the Estravel River, Luminara functions as the manufacturing and cultural heart of the coalition. Rather than producing raw materials, Luminara transforms the goods flowing downriver — grain, meat, leather, clay, and ore — into high-value finished products. This central position made it the workshop of the coalition, producing everything from fine tools and clothing to preserved foods and luxury goods.

burgs.name: Eos
burgs.note: The city of light! Capital of Aurelia and dominant trade city in Luminara for centuries.

burgs.name: Thronaria
burgs.note:
Originally settled by Cis men and called Columbia after the river.

They imprisoned man trans women here who were set free, reclaimed the city, and became the owners. They promptly renamed it Thronaria since every woman was now a princess.

The glitzy sin city of Luminara where the women forced into convents gathered to leave their lives of repression behind them. They have a live-let-live hedonistic mentality.

burgs.name: Vespera
burgs.note: The feral huntress city of Vespera lies deep in the wild woodlands upstream from Luminara. Home to the coalition’s most skilled trackers and archers, Vespera is less a traditional city and more a collection of lodges and tree platforms woven into the forest itself. Its people embrace a wild, untamed way of life — fluid, expressive, and deeply connected to the land. They move freely between the settlement and the deep woods, following the rhythms of the hunt. Revered for their self-reliance and deadly accuracy, the Vesperans supply the coalition with meat, fine furs, leather, and elite warriors.

burgs.name: Vaelora
burgs.note: Perched dramatically atop high cliffs overlooking the mouth of the Estravel River, Vaelora serves as the undisputed economic heart of the Valoran coalition. Its position at the river’s end, where the waters plunge over the cliffs in a great waterfall, forces all trade to pass through its ingenious cliffside cargo lift system. This natural choke point made Vaelora extraordinarily wealthy. Known for its cosmopolitan outlook, maritime culture, and shrewd merchants, Vaelora controlled all external trade for the coalition and served as its primary gateway to the outside world.

burgs.name: Sicklesheaf
burgs.note: Located in the fertile grasslands along a major tributary, Sickle Sheaf is the primary agricultural heartland of the Valoran coalition. This sprawling settlement began as a collection of large farming estates and grew into a major town that feeds much of the river system. It is known for its vast wheat fields, cattle herds, and massive granaries. The people of Sickle Sheaf are practical, generous, and deeply tied to the seasonal rhythms of planting and harvest. Their grain, flour, and livestock are shipped downriver to Luminara for processing and to Vaelora for export.

burgs.name: Dikereth
burgs.note:
Dikereth

Nestled in the rugged, mineral-rich hills upstream from Luminara, Dikereth is the coalition's hardy industrial heart. It began as a mining settlement on the slopes of Mt Modelia, where the coal seams break the surface, and grew fat on the industrial revolution: the mines at the mountain's foot, the High Crag terrace and the Southface colliery now feed a ring of bloomeries, forges and workshops that smelt ore and turn out iron tools, nails, blades and simple weapons rather than shipping heavy raw metal downriver.

Coal made the town. Once the easy seams were worked out the workings climbed the slopes, and the freight railway came to carry coal and coke down to the forges and finished iron away to the coast. Smoke rises constantly over the town and the ringing of hammers is a constant sound; the people are blunt, hardworking and no-nonsense, proud of their role as the coalition's primary producers of practical, durable goods.

burgs.name: Thorn
burgs.note: Biggest grain shipper and gateway of trade for all Aurelia

burgs.name: Tilavenva
burgs.note: Popular destination for lovers to make a stay when on weary journies.

burgs.name: Harveil
burgs.note: Home to the largest school in Luminara

burgs.name: Estmarch
burgs.note:
Originally a fort erected in defense of the wealthy capital.

They dont want to be a tool of the wealthy anymore post revolution!

burgs.name: Saffwind
burgs.note: Founded up the river, famous for shipping artisanal products.

burgs.name: Bricksville
burgs.note: The greatest stone masons in Aurelia, versatile in all manner of craftsmanship began here.

burgs.name: Ausia
burgs.note: Gateway of the forests, ship manufacturer supreme, timber export

burgs.name: Florin's Valley
burgs.note: Renowned eternal flower garden of Luminara. The arcadia of the continent

burgs.name: Cholis
burgs.note: The fortified stone miners became the city of marble

burgs.name: Gildingspring
burgs.note: The spring where gold flows, a powerful trade hub with beautiful golden autumn leaves and flowers pressed into fashion to die for.

burgs.name: Herdensa
burgs.note: Raised livestock and grew crops to support the growth of Bricksville

burgs.name: Veilterscepter
burgs.note:
A city founded by exconventica who were fleeing the convents during the chaos of the blooming war.

Started as a female monestary disguised, was actually a trans polycule. Became a major city after the war.

burgs.name: Luseneros
burgs.note: A town that has seen many battles in an effort to protect the aurelian gold found in them thar hills.

burgs.name: Saffron
burgs.note:
A city in the hills populated in the past by highly trained archers to defend the gold deposit.

They projected authority in the region but relied heavily on state backed support for growth.

burgs.name: The Pass
burgs.note: A mountain pass city where the frontier was guarded and fought over by both ancient luminaran and ancien settlers. Ultimately veterans claimed it as a stronghold prior to the Blooming war. It served as an important base of operations for the princess.

states.name: Angelos
states.note:
Angelos is not land at all, but a floating island: a 22-cell slab of soil and rock lifted into the sky, centered near 638, 498. Elevations run 26–44 ft above its own root-line, so the whole state is a plateau. It carries one city, Luminaris, and one province.

Because the island is airborne, it has no coast, no rivers and no ports — every route to it is vertical, and its only neighbors are the states its shadow passes over.

provinces.name: Dikereth
provinces.note: Dikereth province, the industrial core of Modellia. The coal seams of Mt Modelia and the forges of Dikereth town made it the coalition's manufacturing heart; the railway carries coal down the slope and finished iron away to market.

religions.name: Ancien Messianic Christianity
religions.deity: Grey Lord, Reborn Son of Man

rivers.name: Estroveil
rivers.note:
First Landing of the trans people.

The river is the largest on the island with passive waters fit for speedy travel up and down stream and home to some of its largest cities.

It spans multiple biomes and elevations cultivating a rich trade network across the region and connecting the center of the province with its south.

The disparity of connectivity between the two parts of Luminara is so great that early Luminarans survived in exile north of the river for 3 generations and resettled the region after The Blooming War.

rivers.name: Vitamin
rivers.note: Originally called Vitality but the settlers were all american cis men so they're dumb.

markers.name: The Grove
markers.note: The grove where Zenia laid the sword, Calantha's Return.

markers.name: Mt Modelia
markers.note: Mt Modelia, the coal mountain. Its forested flanks hide the seams that built Dikereth's forges: the Old Slope adit, the Modelia Main Seam, the High Crag terrace and the Southface colliery, all linked by the freight railway down to the town.

markers.name: University of Excellence
markers.note: Luminara's top university, built post council takeover
